title: Minimum Refueling Stops
problemStatement: A vehicle starts with a certain amount of fuel and must reach a destination. Along the route are fuel stations at known distances, each providing a certain amount of fuel. Determine the minimum number of refueling stops required to reach the destination. If impossible, print -1.
input: • First line contains integers Target and StartFuel. • Second line contains integer N. • Next N lines each contain the station position and available fuel.
output: Print the minimum number of refueling stops.
